sources: Enemy definitions merged (first occurrence wins) from data/enemies/{mad-forest,inlaid-library,dairy-plant,gallo-tower}-enemies.json; see those files for wiki sources

field_notes.hp: max health at spawn before stage multiplier (Mad Forest enemy_health = 1.0)
field_notes.speed: wiki MoveSpeed units (player base speed unit is not stated on these pages; treat as relative)
field_notes.knockback: multiplier on weapon knockback (0 = wiki lists 0, i.e. described as semi/fully resistant depending on page text; negative = pulled toward player)
field_notes.hp_x_level: true means health is multiplied by the player's level at spawn time

BAT1.name: Pipeestrello 1 (Little Pipeestrello)
BAT1.special: chases player; wiki lists freeze/kill/debuff resistance 0

BAT4.name: Pipeestrello 4 (Glowing Bat)
BAT4.special: boss; HP x player level; Arcana-holder variant spawns at 11:00 and 21:00 only when Arcanas enabled; also appears as a regular enemy in minutes 28-29

SKELETON.name: Skeleton
SKELETON.special: variants SKELETON..SKELETON4 (same stats); no ranged behaviour listed

XLMANTIS.name: Mantichana
XLMANTIS.special: semi-resistant to knockback; used as the 5:00 boss with these normal stats (wiki lists no separate boss stats for that instance) and as a regular enemy at 16:00

XLMUMMY.name: Big Mummy
XLMUMMY.special: semi-resistant to knockback; same statline as Mantichana and Venus

FLOWER.name: Flower Wall
FLOWER.special: very slow; HP x player level; page text says reduced knockback; used in the Flower Wall ring event and as a regular enemy minutes 21-24, 26

XLFLOWER.name: Venus
XLFLOWER.special: semi-resistant to knockback; 21:00 and 24:00 boss instances use these stats (no separate boss stats listed); regular enemy 25-26

BOSS_XLDEATH.name: The Reaper
BOSS_XLDEATH.special: spawns 30:00 and each minute after; rushes player; contact deals lethal damage

MUD.name: Dust Elemental
MUD.special: chases player; wiki statbox id MUD

DULL0.name: Testa di Mano 1
DULL0.special: reduced knockback; used for the wave tables' plain 'Testa di Mano' entries (wiki lists 3 variants and the wave table does not say which; DULL0 is an approximation choice)

DULL1.name: Testa di Mano 2 (Elite Dullahan)
DULL1.special: reduced knockback; 'Elite Dullahan' redirects to Testa di Mano 2

MEDUSA1.name: Sneaky Head
MEDUSA1.special: Floaty + Fixed Direction: moves horizontally in a wavy pattern, does not home; wiki max speed 340 (not modelled); used by Medusa Wall/Swarm events

MEDUSA1_FAST.name: Fast Sneaky Head
MEDUSA1_FAST.special: Floaty + Fixed Direction; used by Medusa Wall/Swarm events only

MEDUSA2.name: Big Sneaky Head
MEDUSA2.special: Floaty + Fixed Direction; also used for the wave-table entry 'Medusa Head' at 14:00 (that link points at another stage's enemy; the sprite is Big Sneaky Head, so this is an approximation)

SKULL2_SWARM.name: Skullone (swarm)
SKULL2_SWARM.special: Fixed Direction: beelines across the screen at high speed, no collision with other enemies; used by the unsupported skull_swarm event

SHADERED.name: Sig.ra Rossi (Red Shade)
SHADERED.special: chases the player at high speed, self-destructs after a couple of seconds for high damage; HP x player level; used by the unsupported shade_bomb event

BOSS_MEDUSA1.name: Colossal Sneaky Head (boss)
BOSS_MEDUSA1.special: boss, HP x player level; also a regular enemy in minute 28

BOSS_MUD.name: Colossal Dust Elemental (boss)
BOSS_MUD.special: boss, HP x player level; also a regular enemy in minute 29

BOSS_XLMEDUSA.name: Queen Medusa (Merdusa boss)
BOSS_XLMEDUSA.special: boss, HP x player level; partially resistant to freeze

BOSS_COUNT2.name: Nesuferit (Nesufritto)
BOSS_COUNT2.special: boss, HP x player level; chest can evolve up to 3 weapons

BOSS_MERMAN.name: Merman (boss)
BOSS_MERMAN.special: boss; HP x player level; also used as a regular enemy in minute 28

LIZARD2_3.name: Lizard Rook
LIZARD2_3.special: regular enemy; also the 1:00 boss (wiki lists no separate boss id or HP x Level for it)

MIGNO_3_5SWARM.name: Mignotaur (rush)
MIGNO_3_5SWARM.special: Minotaur Rush event unit; fixed direction

BOSS_MIGNO2_5_L.name: Minotaur Boss (large)
BOSS_MIGNO2_5_L.special: boss; HP x player level; also a regular enemy at 28:00

JELLYFISH.name: Jellyfish (wall)
JELLYFISH.special: Jellyfish Wall event unit; fixed direction

JELLYFISH2_SWARM.name: Jellyfish (swarm)
JELLYFISH2_SWARM.special: Jellyfish Swarm event unit; fixed direction

XLARMOR_SWORD.name: Sword Guardian (Giant Armored Knight)
XLARMOR_SWORD.special: regular enemy; also spawned as the 24:00 boss-slot entry (no chest listed)

BOSS_STALKER_NORMAL.name: The Stalker
BOSS_STALKER_NORMAL.special: The Stalker map event: follows the player for the event duration; HP x player level

SKELANGUE.name: Scarleton
SKELANGUE.special: chases player; has 3 lives (resurrects twice; no resurrection if killed by Pentagram/Gorgeous Moon/Rosary/Heaven Sword; drops a gem each death); also the 1:00 boss (no chest)

GHOST2.name: Ghost 2 (Red Ghost)
GHOST2.special: wiki knockback 0; GHOST in other stages has the same stats

HARPYV.name: Harzia V (Wandering Harzia)
HARPYV.special: movement fixed on the vertical axis; Fixed Direction (moves on a fixed axis)

XLMAGIO.name: Undead Mage
XLMAGIO.special: shoots a bullet every 2 seconds (BULLET_2: hp 1, power 25, speed 250; not modelled); takes no knockback; also the 4:00 boss and the Pile Assault enemy

DEVIL3.name: Elite Devil
DEVIL3.special: boss; named only by sprite in the wave table (3:00, 5:00, 12:00, 14:00, 16:00, 22:00)

BOSS_XLDRAGON1.name: Dragon Shrimp 1 (boss) (Colossal Bone Dragon)
BOSS_XLDRAGON1.special: boss; also used in the 29:00 pool

BOSS_XLDRAGON2.name: Dragon Shrimp 2 (boss) (Colossal Flame Dragon)
BOSS_XLDRAGON2.special: boss; also used in the 29:00 pool

BOSS_XLARMOR2.name: Archon Disco (boss) (Shield Guardian)
BOSS_XLARMOR2.special: boss; reduced knockback; resistant to freeze

BOSS_XLCRAB.name: Giant Enemy Crab
BOSS_XLCRAB.special: boss (25:00); 2 Pincers that grow when damaged and regenerate, each pincer has 17 lives; can summon a Drowner if the player stays below it; first kill unlocks Hyper Gallo Tower

BOSS_XLDROWNER.name: The Drowner XL
BOSS_XLDROWNER.special: summoned at 30:00 with the Reaper; wiki says it cannot be defeated

XLDRAGON1_FLAG.name: Dragon Shrimp 1 (flag)
XLDRAGON1_FLAG.special: Dragon Swarm/Stream event enemy; no collision; fixed horizontal axis; Fixed Direction (moves on a fixed axis)

XLDRAGON2_FLAG.name: Dragon Shrimp 2 (flag)
XLDRAGON2_FLAG.special: Dragon Swarm event enemy; no collision; fixed horizontal axis; Fixed Direction (moves on a fixed axis)

BATSWARM.name: Pipeestrello (swarm)
BATSWARM.special: Fixed Direction: moves in a straight line, does not target the player, pushes other enemies; immune to defang

unknowns: Green Acres has no wave table; +50% enemy health is applied via the stage modifier, not baked into hp.
